lines.text: Paul urges Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord, and asks his true yokefellow to help them.
Euodia and Syntyche contended at Paul's side for the gospel, along with Timothy and his other fellow workers.
Paul tells them to rejoice in the Lord always and to let their gentleness be apparent to all.
Paul says to be anxious for nothing and to present requests to God, and his peace will guard their hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
Paul tells them to think on whatever is true, honorable, right, pure, lovely and admirable, promising the God of mercy will be with them.
